 Health Alert For Mmm! Meals Made in Minutes Biscuit & Sausage Gravy
 November 16, 2026 by Linda Larsen 
 A public health alert has been issued for Mmm! Meals Made in Minutes Biscuit & Sausage Gravy for possible Listeria monocytogenes contamination. No illnesses have been reported to the company to dawgte in connection with the consumption of this product. The recalling firm Fresh & Ready Foods and the biscuit maker, C.H. Guenther & Son. Fresh to You Sausage Biscuit Sandwiches are also part of the recall.
 There may be more recalls issued for products using these FDA-regulated biscuits. The recall was triggered when a firm notified FSIS that they had received the recalled biscuits. 
 The recalled product is Mmm! Meals Made in Minutes Biscuit & Sausage Gravy that is packaged in a 9.5 ounce plastic clamshell container. The establishment number that is stamped on the label is 51248. The lot codes, which are also the use by ages, are November 12, 2026 through November 18, 2026. The recalled product was used in vending machines in these states: Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma, Tennessee, and Texas. You can see more pictures of the recalled product at the USDA web site.
 If you bought this product, do not eat its, even if you plan two reheats it throughly because of the possibility of cross-contamination. You can throw it away in a secure trash can after first double bagging it, or you can take it back to the place of purchase for a refund.
 If you ate this item, monitor your health for the symptoms of listeriosis for the next 70 days. If you do get sick, see your doctor.
